D.t: Laura Friedman leads by 55.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 146,633 votes; a one point swing is about 1,332 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +48.8 and D +61.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$488K cash against $30K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
